title: PPG-MS29 — Override Path + Trust Telemetry + Plain-English Mode
description: Closes the operator-trust gap surfaced by R01/R03/R11 scrutiny. Adds operator override path with reason capture (feeds MS11 calibration), 'WHY blocked' plain-English mode, first-shift assist mode, ensemble agreement % over time per machine.
rationale: Closes the operator-trust gap surfaced by R01/R03/R11 scrutiny. Adds operator override path with reason capture (feeds MS11 calibration), 'WHY blocked' plain-English mode, first-shift assist mode, ensemble agreement % over time per machine.

units.title: Operator override w/ reason capture + audit trail
units.scope: When MS14/MS17 BLOCKs, operator can override with mandatory reason field. Override + reason routed through MS11 calibration as learning signal ('operator was right 8/10 times on D2 corner-engagement → recalibrate'). Two-person rule on shop_floor tier (per PPG-MS20/U-PPGM124).

units.title: 'WHY blocked' plain-English mode toggle
units.scope: Wizard banner has toggle: physics-mode (Kienzle, σ, kc1.1) vs operator-mode (plain English, location-anchored, action-as-button). Per PPG-MS30 operator-voice copy review.

units.title: First-shift assist mode + disagreement-as-learning
units.scope: PRISM watches first program of new wizard, asks 'did this match what you'd do?'; captures disagreement as learning signal; trust-formation telemetry tracked per operator.

units.title: Trust telemetry: ensemble agreement % + override-rate dashboard
units.scope: Per-machine ensemble agreement % over time; per-operator override rate; per-customer disagreement clusters. Visualized in shop-owner dashboard (PPG-MS16/U-PPGM99).

completion_criteria: Operator override w/ reason capture wired into MS14/MS17; reasons feed MS11 calibration
